objective: Explain the six step-1 contacts classified as slip under zero applied tangential load; reproduce the eight-step M4 stick ramp and capture fields needed for independent reaction recovery.

case.name: R10 M4 stick_target
case.supports: all translations fixed at x=0; master plane fixed

contact.formulation: fixed initial-search node-to-triangle, normal Lagrange multipliers, regularized tangential Coulomb return
contact.normal_multiplier_unit: N; the solver's field name 'pressure' is a nodal constraint multiplier, not Pa

classification_review.documented_stick_criterion: ||k_t*(relative-slip_reference)|| <= mu*max(p,0) + contact_friction_tolerance, except for prior-slip hysteresis
classification_review.source_observation_at_57e04bf3: _friction_update compares the force norm and mu*p to operator.tolerance; _operator sets operator.tolerance from FrictionlessContact.gap_tolerance. The configured contact_friction_tolerance is passed to the increment solver but is not passed to _friction_update.
classification_review.must_not_assume: A zero global tangential load does not imply zero local tangential forces or displacements.

per_contact_per_iteration: active flag and gap in m
normal multiplier and mu*p capacity in N
relative tangential displacement and slip-reference in m
trial and returned tangential force in N
gap tolerance provenance and configured friction tolerance
per_accepted_step: full displacement vector and applied load vector
fixed DOF map and TET4 node/element arrays
all contact states, gaps, normal multipliers, tangential forces and references
free and global balance metrics, residuals, step time and RSS
capture.raw_archive: compressed NPZ plus JSONL files retained only in the local controlled run store; not included in the product commit

budget_basis: The uninstrumented v2 ramp used 30.2 s wall time and 495276032 sampled peak RSS bytes; prior M4 slip used 343 s and 479 MiB. Instrumented output is expected below 2 MiB raw, with 480 s and 768 MiB retained as conservative soft limits.
termination: Stop at the first solver rejection, failed gate, process limit, timeout, or archive validation failure. Preserve partial outputs; do not retry under this scope or ledger.

comparisons.historical_stick: Same nominal M4 stick case and gates; source predates normal-constraint scaling. Raw archive is missing, so aggregate-only comparison.
comparisons.historical_slip: Different tangential load (450 N versus 150 N) and solver source predates the overflow-recovery guard. Not a strict before/after comparison.
